groups.activity: side with the Grineer when a Strun Wraith part is the reward
groups.meta: 3 missions for the same side pays the reward

rows.label: Strun Wraith Blueprint
rows.note: 1.11% per Grineer-side invasion; MR 10 to acquire

conditions: Only the Grineer side pays Strun Wraith parts; the Corpus side pays Vandal parts and Infested outbreaks pay no weapon parts.
Finish the third mission before the node hits 100%, or you get nothing; switching sides resets progress.
Nothing makes the parts appear more often; watch invasions and jump on any part right away.
bonuses: You get paid even if your side loses, and extra runs past 3 add nothing.
Karak, Latron and Twin Vipers Wraith and Sheev parts also come from Grineer-side invasions and give Mastery.

disclosures.title: the wait
disclosures.body: Collecting four specific 1.11% rewards averages about 190 Grineer-side invasion rewards: 22 for the first piece, then 30, 45 and 90 for the last. Months of checking, mostly for the final piece. Every part is tradeable, so buying the missing one from another player is the common shortcut.

disclosures.title: invasion hazards
disclosures.body: Finishing 5 Grineer-side invasions sends the Zanuka Hunter after you; it's harmless at most levels and drops Detron parts. The Fortuna bounty paying invasion resources pays no weapon parts.
